test_title: PYST 04: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 07 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the center (but not necessarily in the same order). F is sitting fourth to the right of D. E is sitting second to the left of F. B is sitting to the immediate left of G. A is not an immediate neighbour of F.

How many people are sitting between C and D when counted from the right of D?
solution:
Given:

Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the center.

F is sitting fourth to the right of D. E is sitting second to the left of F.

B is sitting to the immediate left of G. A is not an immediate neighbour of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/122d5fd7e8e975b984e83dcfe584569130f0e73a837e0ee78307697e62065233.png] 

Thus, two people sitting between D and C when counted from the right of D

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
